reviews.author: BillATech11

reviews.title: Basic SSD with reasonable speed
reviews.comment:
This is definitely not your high end SSD drive, but does the job just fine for installing an OS on a work laptop for instance. It has reasonable speed, and so far don't appears to have faulty sectors. Time will tell though.
A small Philips screwdriver was also included with the drive, which makes the installation much quicker, instead of having to go look for my own tools.
Also, keep in mind that this drive is a M2 NVMe with the two slots on the connector side (see photos), and will not be compatible with all NVMe/PCIe ports.
reviews.author: Orcatrainer
